content: ETL means extract, transform, load. It moves data from source systems, applies transformations, and loads a destination. In this synthetic example, an ETL process feeds the campaign dashboard from transaction records. Inconsistent dashboard data requires checking the transformation and load steps. This is demonstration evidence, not a real company incident.
